name: CSRF on authenticated state-changing endpoint

input.title: POST /account/email does not require CSRF token; relies only on session cookie
input.summary: The endpoint sets SameSite=None (cross-site iframe usage requires it). CSRF protection layer is missing. A malicious page can submit a cross-origin form to change the victim's email and trigger password reset.
input.root_cause: No CSRF middleware; SameSite=None required by third-party embed use case

rationale: Spec §39 hard bug recall target. Reproduced in lab: PoC page changed victim's email to attacker@evil.tld in 3 seconds.
